en: A vintage black and white postcard showing a hilly landscape with a few scattered buildings surrounded by vegetation. The layout is typical of early 20th-century postcards, with printed captions and handwritten text on the lower part. The printed text states the location as 'ZANTE (Grèce)' and 'Pochalis (Environs de Zante).' The card features a mix of Greek and French in its labeling, as well as handwritten Greek script.
